Our mother, aged 85, underwent bilateral Total Knee Replacement surgery under Dr Sudhir Joshi (Shree Samarth Nursing Home, Dadar) on 10th February 2026.

Dr. Tanvi from Praj - The Rehab Sphere continued her physiotherapy after discharge and was instrumental in her recovery. She combined patience with the right amount of encouragement, ensuring that our mother remained consistent with her exercises.

Today, less than four months after surgery, our mother is able to walk independently without a walker or stick. We appreciate Dr. Tanvi and the Praj - The Rehab Sphere Clinic team for their dedication and support throughout the rehabilitation journey.
